nodes.label: Magic-Link BFF & Cookie Session Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses six Netlify Functions to store the refresh token in an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie and keep the access JWT in memory only, with persistSession:false and autoRefreshToken:false.

nodes.label: AAL2 MFA Refresh & Backup Code Recovery Contract
nodes.rationale: Upgrades the session to AAL2 inside POST /api/auth/refresh and writes the rotated AAL2 refresh cookie directly so page reloads preserve AAL2 without re-prompting TOTP.
